name: Tempester n°35: the Load Sound knob walks a folder in alphabetical order again
explanation: Tempester n°35: the Load Sound knob walks a folder in alphabetical order again (Main 1.5.0.2, request #25). Before: the Sounds screen loads "index" ctx+0x170 of folder ctx+0x172 with [routine] (calls [address], [address]) and shows its name with [routine] ([routine], [address]). Both end in [routine], which walks the directory: the first entry is skipped, "." and ".." are not counted, and index i is the (count - 1 - i)-th real entry in directory order. Nothing sorts: DSI removed the sort in 1.5.0.2 ("not adequate code space", cbmd msg6781). The sorter still exists for the Save/Load browser: [routine] fills the shared list [address] (entries of 0x20 bytes: name, +0x1C raw index) and qsorts it with [routine] (strcmp on the names). It is not reused: it gets each name through [routine], which recounts and rewalks the directory, so n names cost about n * 2n directory reads (11,552 for the 76 factory snares), against about 6n for one knob step. After: MAP turns the knob position into the raw index. On the first use of a folder (or when ctx+0x174, the count the Sounds screen took at the navigation start or folder change, differs from the count of the list), BUILD walks the directory once (same skips as [routine]: first entry, ".", ".."), writes each name (27 characters at most) with its raw index count - 1 - k into the shared list, checks it found exactly the counted files, and sorts it with the browser's own qsort call (same comparator, so the same order as the Save/Load browser). Then position i loads and shows list[i].raw. The list is kept for later steps: tag (folder + 1) [address], sorted flag [address], count [address]. When it cannot be sorted (empty folder, more than 256 files: the list holds 256 entries before the next object at [address], or the directory disagrees with the count) the knob keeps the directory order and the attempt is not repeated until the folder or the count changes. Sharing the list with the browser: BUILD clears the browser's "list built" flag ctx+0x48 (the browser rebuilds it at its next entry), and the browser's call to [routine] goes through INVAL, which clears the tag first. A file added or renamed in the folder while the count stays the same keeps the old order until the next folder change or count change; the name shown is always the one loaded (both go through MAP). RAM: [address]-[address] in the .bss hole [address]-[address]; the list [address]-[address] (the browser's). Context: main loop (UI dispatch). Flasher page untouched.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07da08 ; Load Sound step: was "jal [address]" ([routine]); delay slot "sw t1,0x10(sp)" (index) kept
jal 0x9d07da08 ; navigation start: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "sw t6,0x10(sp)" (index) kept
jal 0x9d07da4c ; [routine], name of the sound being browsed: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "addu a3,s1,zero" kept
jal 0x9d07da00 ; [routine], browser entry: was "jal [address]" ([routine]); delay slot kept
sb zero,-0x7c32(gp) ; delay slot: tag [address] = 0, the shared list is the browser's again
lw a1,0x38(sp) ; delay slot: knob position = [routine]'s 5th argument (caller's 0x10(sp))
sw v0,0x38(sp) ; raw index in its place
j [address] ; [routine](beat, pad, 0, folder, raw index), returns to the Sounds screen
or a1,a2,zero ; delay slot: knob position
j [address] ; [routine](0, folder, raw index, buffer): the name, returns to [routine]
lhu a1,-0x79f4(gp) ; ctx+0x174: count taken at the navigation start or folder change
lhu t2,-0x7c30(gp) ; count of the list
or v0,s1,zero ; directory order unless sorted
beq t3,zero,0x9d07daec ; past the list: unchanged ([routine] refuses it as before)
sb zero,-0x7c31(gp) ; not sorted until the list is complete
sb t0,-0x7c32(gp) ; tag = folder + 1: this attempt, not repeated before the folder or the count changes
sh a1,-0x7c30(gp) ; count of the list
beq t0,zero,0x9d07dc3c ; more than 256 files: more than the list holds, directory order kept
lbu t0,-0x7ea7(gp) ; [address], drive in use: 0 = sounds (as [routine])
jal [address] ; first entry, skipped as in [routine]
addiu a1,sp,0x60 ; directory entry (152 bytes, name at +1)
beq t0,zero,0x9d07dc3c ; more files than counted: directory order kept
sw t6,0x1c(t4) ; raw index count - 1 - k ([routine] counts from the last entry)
addiu t8,t4,0x1b ; last name byte the entry keeps
sb zero,-0x1(t4) ; name cut at 27 characters, the raw index at +0x1C untouched
bne s2,s1,0x9d07dc3c ; fewer files than counted: directory order kept
jal [address] ; qsort(list, count, 0x20, [routine]): the browser's sort
sh zero,-0x7b20(gp) ; ctx+0x48 = 0: the browser rebuilds its list at its next entry
